capabilities: Render inline Leaflet maps from Whereday, OwnTracks, Overland, GeoJSON, and GPX exports
Plot duration-encoded visit markers and GPS route polylines
Filter visits, routes, and outings by day and time of day
Show export stats such as visit count, distance, and top repeated place
Insert compact figures and Field Journal notes from loaded exports
disambiguation: Not a general map embed tool; it renders location-tracking export files stored in the vault, not arbitrary geographic data.
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Basemap tile requests go to the selected external provider, but a no-basemap mode avoids all tile requests. OSM tiles are blocked on desktop due to referer policy.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize location-tracking data such as visited places and GPS tracks from export files inside notes.
